hook.name: QSimpleLaunch
hook.description: Uniswap v4 hook and launch factory for tokens, with configurable guards (open delay, anti-snipe, wallet cap, cooldown, holder gate) and optional fee splits (trading taxes, buyback/burn, referrals, creator). Takes fees via beforeSwap and afterSwap deltas, tracks a bonding target tick, and permanently holds the launch liquidity position. Pools are only created by the hook itself during launch.
